Jiang Zhi was a good person in her past life. She was so good that she was placed on a pedestal and married a scumbag for the sake of her family’s fate. It was a painful life, but in the end, her family still felt that she did not do well enough.
When given a chance to start over, Jiang Zhi expressed that she would reject emotional blackmail and choose her own fate!
Hence…
Father Jiang, “Your husband likes to watch beautiful women dance. Do you want to go get lessons?”
Jiang Zhi smiled and nodded. The next day, she went to apply for a boxing class and beat up the scumbag at the red-light district.
Stepsister, “Hey, stop working out. Only by being as weak as me can men have the desire to protect you.”
Jiang Zhi smiled. “I can beat ten weaklings like you with one hand.”

building-a-business-empire-with-my-techn:
Michael Reyes is your typical college student, caught in the relentless cycle of balancing studies and part-time work. As a second-year mechanical engineering student, his days are packed from dawn till dusk. Mornings are dedicated to lectures and coursework, while afternoons are spent at a part-time job that helps him make ends meet. Evenings are his only respite, though often spent more on studying than sleeping, if he gets the chance to rest at all.
His life is a constant juggle, trying to keep up with demanding academic requirements while also contributing financially to his household. He's a hardworking, average student – not the top of his class, but not at the bottom either.
But Michael's life takes an unexpected turn when he gains access to a mysterious Technological System. This system offers him a glimpse into future technologies, granting him knowledge and tools far beyond his time.
When he realized its potential, his first words are.
“I'm going to be rich!”
Follow as Michael build his own business empire rivaling Apple, Microsoft, even Google.
Disclaimer: 'Building a Business Empire with my Technological System' is a work of fiction.…

But they soon learn that in this world, humanity, cornered and outnumbered by other species, survives within the confines of one city. reborn-to-love:
“So, what do you want?” He Xinyan quickly glanced up into Gu Yechen’s face and frowned. Why did he look so familiar? Where did she see him before?
“I want you.”
“. . .” Well, that was direct.
He Xinyan opened her mouth to speak but she couldn’t form the right words.
“Let's make a deal. You become my girlfriend and you can ask for anything in return.”
“Anything?” He Xinyan repeated.
Gu Yechen nodded his head, “Anything.”
He Xinyan thought about what could help her but realized that there wasn’t much she needed as of now. However, she would definitely need support in the future.
There were many things she couldn’t do by herself, but Gu Yechen would definitely be able to do.
“How long would this deal last?”
Gu Yechen leaned back against the couch casually, “However long I feel like.”
“And. . . that is about how long?”
“Forever.”

rise-of-the-arms-dealer-in-the-world-war:
Rise of the Arms Dealer in the World War tells the story of a man from the modern world, thrown back in time to a pivotal moment in history. Armed with knowledge of advanced weaponry and the sharp instincts of a seasoned weapons dealer, he wastes no time in exploiting the chaos of historical wars and political upheavals.
Building an empire not just in arms but across industries, he crafts vehicles, machinery, and technology far beyond the reach of his time. With each calculated move, his influence spreads like wildfire, positioning him to control the tides of conflict.
After World War I, he seizes the opportunity to buy up factories and cutting-edge technologies from the defeated nations, biding his time to prepare for the next global war. His eyes are set on World War II, where he plans to sell weapons on an unprecedented scale, shaping the course of history.
A villain at heart, he is cold, calculating, and without a shred of principle. He deals to whoever bids the most, indifferent to the consequences. As his empire grows, so does the power he wields, but with it comes a relentless struggle to keep the forces he's unleashed in check.
sold-to-the-alphas-i-hate:
Eira thought there could be nothing worse than being abducted by she-wolf traffickers, abused, tormented, and ultimately sold off to five powerful Alphas as nothing more than a breeder.
She was wrong. The worst was yet to come.
She was sold to the same five alphas who had ruined her life and were the reason for every torment she had gone through over the past six years.
The Alphas were just as stunned to see her, yet they had no choice but to accept her for the sake of their pack’s future. Because pureblood she-wolves were rare, nearly extinct. Only they could bear the offspring of powerful Alphas, and ensure the survival and strength of the next generation.
She hated them with every broken piece of her soul. And they hated her in return.
The hatred was mutual. So what now?
Eira made a silent vow. She will make them feel every brutal torment she had suffered. Every scar, every tear, every cry in the dark, they will taste it all.
But the Alphas had plans of their own. They will use her. Breed her. And when she was no longer of use… they will kill her.…

vision-grid-system-the-comeback-of-ryoma:
Ryoma Takeda was once a rising star in the ring, an Interhigh champion, a golden boy with fists of promise. But one bitter loss on his pro debut shattered his confidence. A freak accident soon after stole his leg.
His career vanished. His fiancée left him. And all he had left were reruns of that one damn fight… and a hundred different regrets.
Then, just as he hits rock bottom, fate does the unthinkable. He wakes up ten years in the past, on the very night of his first professional match.
But this time, something’s different.
[System Initialized: Vision Grid Active]
“Your eyes see the truth beneath motion. Use it well.”
Armed with the Vision Grid System, a combat-assist module that turns his visual perception into tactical mastery, Ryoma now has a second chance.
To fix his mistakes.
To chase the career he lost.
To protect the mother he failed.
And to prove to the woman who left… that she let go of someone she’ll never replace.
But boxing isn't just a sport. It's war of bodies, of minds, of hearts.
And Ryoma Takeda is done losing.
